evidence.text:
git add -A && git config user.name "openhands" && git config user.email "openhands@all-hands.dev" && git commit -m "simplify.sqrtdenest: avoid IndexError when split_surds sees no surds

Handle empty input in _split_gcd by returning a neutral gcd and empty groups.
This prevents sqrtdenest from raising IndexError for expressions that cannot
be denested (e.g., involving I), and returns the expression unchanged instead.

Co-authored-by: openhands <openhands@all-hands.dev>"
